Your mission:
 As an OT Security Engineer, you are part of multiple customer projects at various project stages:
You implement integration plans for security solutions and support our technical departments with implementation,
You support network segmentation and system hardening efforts,
You perform vulnerability assessments and OT-focused penetration testing,
You perform threat and risk analyses, document and continuously improve security measures,
You collaborate with IT, engineering, and production teams,
You support the development of a security architecture for renewable energy plants,
You conduct customer and supplier discussions on security topics throughout all project phases.
 Your profile:
Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Automation Engineering, or a related field,
Professional experience in in OT / ICS security,
Good knowledge of common communication and network protocols, as well as the functionality and procedures of modern IT architectures,
Good knowledge of security technologies and concepts,
Good knowledge of relevant standards such as IEC 62443,
Experience with the creation of threat models and risk analyses,
Experience with security tools (firewalls, SIEM, IDS/IPS), 
Hands-on mentality and structured working style, 
You impress with your conceptual, analytical, and meticulous working style,
Goal orientation and independent work complete your profile,
Fluent knowledge of English is mandatory.
 We welcome applications from people with disabilities and actively promote equal opportunities and diversity.
 You can look forward to:
Working for a better future: With us, you will create a better future for us and all generations after us,
More flexibility: We know how important a good work-life balance is. That's why we offer flexible working hours and a home office model that adapts to your needs.
 What We Offer You
A wide range of benefits to make your employee experience worthwhile: Meal vouchers, cultural vouchers, vacation vouchers, and much more,
A comprehensive medical insurance: To ensure the wellbeing of all our employees.

 About Us
 At meteocontrol, we have been dedicated to renewable energies since 1998 and are one of the world's leading developers of independent energy management systems. With energy into the future. We are looking forward to you!
